The structure of LuMg crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms (Lu8Mg8) distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Lu and Mg centers adopt close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors, though Mg environments exhibit 5 Lu and 7 Mg neighbors, while Lu environments have 5 Lu and 7 Mg neighbors. Validated polyhedron contacts indicate corner- and edge-sharing between 12-vertex Lu and Mg coordination polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional connected network.
